many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

        return segs
    sepC=sorted(Vsep); sepR=sorted(Hsep)
    Cbands=list(zip([-1]+sepC,[i+1 for i,c in enumerate(sepC)]+ [W-1]))  # ranges inclusive? use exclusive

    CB=[(-1, sepC[i]+1) for i in range(len(CB))] if False else []

from collections import defaultdict
def bands(seps,n):
    s=sorted(seps); res=[]; prev=-1
    for x in [-1]+s+[n]:
        lo=x+1
        hi = next((y-1 for y in s if y>x), n-1) if x>=0 else (prev if False else n-1)
        # simpler: hi is next sep minus 1, or n-1
        nxt=[y for y in s if y>x and True]
        hi = min(nxt)-1 if nxt else n-1
        if lo<=hi: res.append((lo,hi))
        prev=hi
    return res
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    Hsep=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==8 for v in inp[r])]
    Vsep=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    RB=bands(Hsep,H); CB=bands(Vsep,W)
    lasth=Hsep[-1] if Hsep else -1; lastv=Vsep[-1] if Vsep else W-1
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c] not in (0,8): pos[inp[r][c]].append((r,c))
    claims=defaultdict(set)
    def band(i): return CB[i] if i<len(CB) else None
    def rbnd(i): return RB[i] if i<len(RB) else None
    for col,pts in pos.items():
        rs=[rbnd(rb(c)) if False else None for rb in []]
        rowbands=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(RB) if any(a<=r<b for r,_ in pts)]
        colbands=[j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(CB) if any(a<=c<b for _,c in pts)]
        rs=[RB[i] for i in rowbands]; cs=[CB[j] for j in colbands]
        vert=all(c==cs[0][0] and b==cs[0][1] for a,b in cs)
        horiz=all(r==rs[0][0] and b==rs[0][1] for a,b in rs)
        if len(cols)==1: pass
        if len(colbands)==1 and len(rowbands)>1:   # vertical
            a,b=CS:=cbands[0]
            for r in range(min(min(x for _,x in pts)),max(x for _,x in pts)+1):
                for c in range(a,b+1):
                    if c in Vsep or r in Hsep: continue
                    if c>lastv: continue
                    claims[(r,c)].add(col)
        elif len(rowbands)==1 and len(colbands)>1:
            a,b=RS:=rbands[0]
            cmin=min(y for _,y in pts); cmax=max(y for _,y in pts)
            for c in range(min(y for _,y in pts),max(y for _,y in pts)+1):
                for r in range(a,b+1):
                    if r in Hsep or c in Vsep: continue
                    if c>lastv: continue
                    claims[(r,c)].add(col)
    out=[list(row) for row in inp]
    for (r,c),sv in claims.items():
        out[r][c]=6 if len(sv)>1 else next(iter(sv))
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    R=[(a,b) for a,b in bands([r for r in range(H) if all(v==8 for v in g[r])],H)]
    C=[(a,b) for a,b in bands([c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))],W)]
    sR=set(r for ra,rb in R for r in (ra,rb))
    sC=set(c for ca,cb in C for c in (ca,cb))
    rbmap={r:i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(R) for r in range(a,b+1)}
    cbmap={c:j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(C) for c in range(a,b+1)}
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    res=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    # vertical color pairs per column
    seen_col=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in marks: seen_col[c].append((r,v))
    for c,rowsv in seen_col.items():
        if len(rowsv)<2: continue
        cols=[r for r,_ in rowsv]; colors=set(v for _,v in rowsv)
        if len(colors)!=1: continue
        v=colors.pop()
        lo,hi=min(cols)-1,max(cols)+1
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            if r in sR or r<0 or r>=H: continue
            j=cbmap[c]; ca,cb=C[j]
            for cc in range(ca,cb+1):
                if res[r][cc]!=0: continue
                res[r][cc]=v
    seen_row=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in marks: seen_row[r].append((c,v))
    done={}
    for r,cols in seen_row.items():
        if len(cols)<2: continue
        rowcol=list(cols); cols=[c for c,_ in rowcol]; colors=set(v for _,v in rowcol)
        if len(colors)!=1: continue
        v=colors.pop()
        lo,hi=min(cols)-1,max(cols)+1
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            if c in sC or c<0 or c>=W: continue
            i=rbmap[r]; ra,rb_=R[i]
            for rr in range(ra,rb_+1):
                if res[rr][c]!=0 and res[rr][c]!=v: res[rr][c]=6
                elif res[rr][c]==0: res[rr][c]=v
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

        d=[(r,c,o[r][c],e[r][c]) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if o[r][c]!=e[r][c]]
        print(d[:15])

def bands(seps, n):
    out=[]; st=0
    for s in seps+[n]:
        if s-st>1: out.append((st,s-1))
        st=s+1
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sR=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==8 for v in g[r])]
    sC=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    RB=bands(sR,H); CB=bands(sC,W)
    mb=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,8): mb[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    res=[list(row) for row in g]
    for v,pts in sorted(mb.items()):
        rows_= [p[0] for p in pts]; cols_=[p[1] for p in pts]
        hz = len(set(rows_))==1   # horizontal pair -> paint rowband, col-extent
        vt = len(set(cols_))==1  # vertical pair -> paint colband, row-extent
        if hz:
            rlo,rhi=min(rows_),max(rows_)
            ri=next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(RB) if a<=rlo<=b)
            lo,hi=rlo,min(max(RB[i]),H-1)
            # extend left until separator or edge
            while lo-1>=0 and lo-1 not in sR: lo-=1
            hi=min(hi,max(RB[i]))
            while hi+1<H and hi+1 not in sR: hi+=1
            lo=max(lo, RB[i][0]); hi=min(hi,RB[i][1])
            for c in range(min(cols_)): pass
            c0,c1=min(cols_),max(cols_)
            lo2=next(j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(CB) if a<=c0<=b)
            # extend col extent left/right until separator or edge
            c2=c0
            while c2-1>=0 and c2-1 not in sC: c2-=1
            c3=c1
            while c3+1<W and c3+1 not in sC: c3+=1
            c2=max(c2,CB[lo2][0]); c3=min(c3,CB[lo2][1])
            for r in range(RB[ri][0],RB[ri][1]+1):
                for c in range(c2,c3+1):
                    if c in sC or r in sR: continue
                    res[r][c]=v
        elif vt:
            clo,chi=min(cols_),max(cols_)
            ji=next(j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(CB) if a<=clo<=b)
            r0,r1=clo,min(max(CB[ji]),W-1)
            r0=max(r0,CB[ji][0]); r1=min(r1,CB[ji][1])
            while r0-1>=0 and r0-1 not in sC: r0-=1
            while r1+1<W and r1+1 not in sC: r1+=1
            r0=max(r0,CB[ji][0]); r1=min(r1,CB[ji][1])
            r2=r0; r3=r1
            while r2-1>=0 and r2-1 not in sC: r2-=1
            while r3+1<H and r3+1 not in sC: r3+=1
            for c in range(CB[ji][0],CB[ji][1]+1):
                for r in range(r2,r3+1):
                    if r in sR or c in sC: continue
                    res[r][c]=v
        # multi-marker colors (e.g. demo2 color 2 with 4 markers): handle via pairing
    return res

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
g=G['Demo pair 2 input']; e=G['Demo pair 2 output']
H=len(g); W=len(g[0])

print(sR,sC)
def bands(seps,n):
    res=[]; prev=-1
    for i in range(n+1):
        if i in seps:
            if prev+1<=i-1: res.append((prev+1,i-1)); prev=i+1
        else: prev=i
    if prev<n: res.append((prev,n))
    return res
RB=bands(sR,H); CB=bands(sC,W)
print('RB',RB,'CB',CB)

def load():
    import os,re,json
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
